name: hud_ui_save_load_sort_entry_range
description: HudUiSaveLoadDialog::SortEntryRange quicksorts large save/load entry ranges down to insertion-sort sized partitions.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4362f0 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4362f0 validates fastcall begin/end, an unused stack argument, immediate return for ranges of 16 entries or fewer, median-of-three pivot selection from first/middle/last entries, inline partition swaps, and tail-recursive sorting of the smaller partition.
The native smoke verifies the threshold no-op for 16 entries and an ascending 17-entry range that the median partition pass orders newer-first.
